控制冥工（1 AP）
支援。选择这名特工可见且位于其 6" 内的一名己方冥工之环冥工（CANOPTEK）特工。也可以改为选择这名特工可见且位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内的一名己方冥工之环冥工特工（此种选择不适用“支援”）。被选特工可以立即免费执行一次消耗 1AP 的行动；在该行动中不能移动超过 2"，若被移除并重新放置，则必须完全放置在原位置 2" 内。
这名特工位于敌方特工的控制范围内或正在反应时，不能执行此行动。

地相干扰（1 AP）
选择一个地形模型上的点，该点必须位于这名特工 8" 内且对其可见。为该点 2" 内的每名特工分别掷 2D6；如果结果高于该特工的剩余耐伤，则对其造成等于两者差值的伤害。
这名特工拥有隐匿命令或位于敌方特工的控制范围内时，不能执行此行动。

cards.website_text_en:
Canoptek Control
SUPPORT. Select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK operative visible to and within 6" of this operative. Alternatively, you can select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK operative that’s visible to this operative and within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX (SUPPORT doesn’t apply to this selection). That selected operative can immediately perform a 1AP action for free; during that action, it cannot move more than 2", or must be set up wholly within 2" if it’s removed and set up again.  This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or while counteracting.

Geomantic Disturbance
Select a point on a terrain feature; that point must be visible to and within 8" of this operative. Separately roll 2D6 for each operative within 2" of that point. If the result is higher than that operative’s remaining wounds, inflict damage on it equal to the difference.

This operative cannot perform this action while it has a Conceal order, or while within control range of an enemy operative.

Molecular Breach
SUPPORT. Select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative visible to and within 6" of this operative. Alternatively, you can select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative visible to this operative and within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX (SUPPORT doesn’t apply to this selection).

The next time the selected operative performs an action in which it moves, don’t move it. Instead, remove it from the killzone and set it back up wholly within a distance equal to its Move stat (or 3" if it was a Dash) horizontally of its
original location (in a killzone that uses the close quarters rules, e.g. Killzone: Tomb World, this distance can be measured over and through Wall terrain and the operative can be set up on the other side). Note that it gains no additional distance when performing the Charge action.
It must be set up in a location it can be placed, and unless it’s the Charge action, it cannot be set up within control range of an enemy operative.

This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

纳米甲虫光束（1 AP）
选择这名特工可见且位于其 6" 内的一名己方冥工之环特工。若这名特工位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内，也可以改为选择矩阵内的另一名己方冥工之环特工。被选特工恢复至多 3D3 点已损失的耐伤。不能选择本转折点已对其使用过“重生”规则的特工。
这名特工位于敌方特工的控制范围内时不能执行此行动；每个转折点最多执行一次。

重生
每个转折点一次，当另一名己方冥工之环特工将要残废时，如果其对这名特工可见且位于其 6" 内，或者两者都位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内，并且两者都不在敌方特工的控制范围内，可以使用本规则。
该己方特工不会残废，而是剩余 1 点耐伤，并且在该行动余下期间不能残废。行动结束后，该己方特工可以立即执行一次免费冲刺，但必须在这名特工的控制范围内或己方方尖碑节点矩阵内结束行动。两名特工的 APL 属性分别减少 1，直到各自下一次激活结束。如果在获救特工的激活期间使用本规则，其激活结束。
这名特工残废时不能使用本规则；若为射击行动且这名特工是主要或次要目标，也不能使用本规则。

Nanoscarab Beam
Select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative visible to and within 6" of this operative. Alternatively, if this operative is within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX, you can select one other friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX. The selected operative regains up to 3D3 lost wounds. It cannot be an operative that the Reanimate rule was used on during this turning point.  This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or more than once per Turning Point.

Reanimate
Once per turning point, when another friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative would be incapacitated, if that operative is visible to and within 6" of this operative, or if this and that operative are within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that operative is within control range of an enemy operative. If you do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining and cannot be incapacitated for the remainder of the action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately perform a free Dash action, but must end that action within this operative’s control range or within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats until the end of their next activations respectively, and if this rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that activation ends.  You cannot use this rule if this operative is incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would be a primary or secondary target.

无尽巨虫
作为第一个转折点之后各转折点的战略计谋，如果未残废的己方冥工之环战士特工少于三名，可以在完全位于己方降落区的位置部署另一名处于备战状态、拥有隐匿命令的战士特工（照常选择其武器选项）。

进攻性防卫
如果这名特工被其 2" 内的一名敌方特工击至残废，在将其移出杀戮区之前掷一枚 D3：结果为 2+ 时，对该敌方特工造成 1 点伤害。

消耗品构体
在对手的杀戮／消灭任务中忽略这名特工，包括其残废时以及确定己方起始特工数量时。在要求特工“逃脱”“存活”或被敌方特工击至残废的胜利条件和 VP 获取条件中，也忽略这名特工，包括已逃脱／存活／残废、确认哪些特工必须逃脱／存活／残废等情况。

cards.website_text_en:
A Ceaseless Scuttling
As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in each turning point after the first, if you have less than three non- incapacitated friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE WARRIOR operatives, you can set up another one ready and with a Conceal order wholly within your drop zone (you can select its weapon options as normal).

Aggressive Defence
If this operative is incapacitated by an enemy operative within 2" of it, before this operative is removed from the killzone, roll one D3: on a 2+, inflict 1 damage on that enemy operative.

Expendable Construct
This operative is ignored for your opponent’s kill/elimination op (when it’s incapacitated, and when determining your starting number of operatives).
It’s also ignored for victory conditions and scoring VPs if either require operatives to ‘escape’, ‘survive’ or be incapacitated by enemy operatives (if it escapes/survives/is incapacitated, determining how many operatives must escape/survive/be incapacitated, etc.).

墓穴爬行者 / Canoptek Tomb Crawler；APL 2；移动 5"；豁免 3+；耐伤 18；底座 50 mm。

跨维隔振器（单一档案）：攻击 5；命中 4+；伤害 5/6；维度放逐（*Dimensional Banishment）。

双联高斯收割炮（集中）：攻击 5；命中 4+；伤害 4/5；穿刺1, 严重（Prc1, Sev）。

利爪（单一档案）：攻击 4；命中 4+；伤害 4/4；无（—）。

关键词：CANOPTEK CIRCLE, NECRON, CANOPTEK, TOMB CRAWLER

维度放逐
这名特工使用此武器后，如果造成了伤害或保留了任何关键成功，且目标没有残废，掷 2D6：若结果高于目标剩余耐伤，则目标残废。本规则优先于阻止特工残废的规则，例如“医疗兵！”或恶角兽掠夺者的“狂暴”；若适用，对手不能为该特工放置重生标识（神圣技师之环）。目标为 NEMESIS 特工或红色恐魔非玩家特工时，本规则无效。

作为第一个转折点的战略计谋，将己方三枚方尖碑节点标识放置在完全位于己方领地的位置。作为第一个转折点之后各转折点的战略计谋，可以将每枚己方方尖碑节点标识水平移动至多 3"。
己方方尖碑节点标识可以控制其 1" 内、没有敌方特工争夺的其他标识（为此将方尖碑节点标识视为己方特工）。如果多名玩家的方尖碑节点标识会控制同一个标识，则没有方尖碑节点标识控制它。
每当一枚己方方尖碑节点标识在水平方向上位于另一枚己方方尖碑节点标识 6" 内，这些标识及其间的区域形成方尖碑节点矩阵，并延伸至上方与下方（杀戮区中的高度不影响此效果）。如果三枚标识都满足条件，则形成更大的组合矩阵。
每当一名己方冥工之环特工位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内：
- 其数据卡上的武器拥有“精准 1”（Accurate 1）武器规则。
- 其 APL 属性增加 1，最多为 3。

cards.website_text_en:
Obelisk Node Matrix
As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first turning point, place your three OBELISK NODE markers wholly within your territory. As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in each turning point after the first, you can move each of your OBELISK NODE markers up to 3" horizontally.
 
Your OBELISK NODE markers control other markers within 1" of them that no enemy operatives contest (treat your OBELISK NODE markers as friendly operatives for this purpose).
If more than one player would use their OBELISK NODE markers to control the same marker, no OBELISK NODE markers control it.

Whenever one of your OBELISK NODE markers is within 6" horizontally of another of your OBELISK NODE markers, those markers and the area between them create an OBELISK NODE MATRIX above and below (in other words, their height in the killzone is irrelevant).
If all three of your OBELISK NODE markers fulfil this, it creates a larger combined OBELISK NODE MATRIX.
Whenever a friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative is within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX:
- Weapons on its datacard have the Accurate 1 weapon rule.
- Add 1 to its APL stat (to a maximum of 3).

Souldrain
Whenever an enemy operative is within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX, or whenever it’s fighting or retaliating against a friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative that’s within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX, subtract 1 from both Dmg stats of that enemy operative’s melee weapons (to a minimum of 2) until the end of the activation/counteraction. Animate Obelisk Nodes
Use this firefight ploy when it’s your turn to activate or counteract. Move any number of your OBELISK NODE markers instead. They can move up to 6" horizontally combined, and distances are always rounded up to the nearest inch (so if you move a marker 1.5", it’s treated as moving it 2"). For example, you could move one marker 6", three markers 1" each, or any combination that doesn’t exceed 6" in total. You can also move them 0" (to effectively skip an activation). In any case, your opponent activates as normal afterwards.

Sacrificial Thrall
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE GEOMANCER operative is selected as the valid target of a Shoot action or to fight against during the Fight action.
Select one other friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK operative visible to and within 3" of that first friendly operative to become the valid target or to be fought against (as appropriate) instead (even if it wouldn’t normally be valid for this).
If it’s the Fight action, treat that other operative as being within the fighting operative’s control range for the duration of that action. If it’s the Shoot action, that other operative is only in cover or obscured if the original target was.

This ploy has no effect if it’s the Shoot action and the ranged weapon has the Blast or Torrent weapon rule.

rule_records.current_text_zh:
作为第一个转折点的战略计谋，将己方三枚方尖碑节点标识放置在完全位于己方领地的位置。作为第一个转折点之后各转折点的战略计谋，可以将每枚己方方尖碑节点标识水平移动至多 3"。
己方方尖碑节点标识可以控制其 1" 内、没有敌方特工争夺的其他标识（为此将方尖碑节点标识视为己方特工）。如果多名玩家的方尖碑节点标识会控制同一个标识，则没有方尖碑节点标识控制它。
每当一枚己方方尖碑节点标识在水平方向上位于另一枚己方方尖碑节点标识 6" 内，这些标识及其间的区域形成方尖碑节点矩阵，并延伸至上方与下方（杀戮区中的高度不影响此效果）。如果三枚标识都满足条件，则形成更大的组合矩阵。
每当一名己方冥工之环特工位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内：
- 其数据卡上的武器拥有“精准 1”（Accurate 1）武器规则。
- 其 APL 属性增加 1，最多为 3。
rule_records.website_text_en:
As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first turning point, place your three OBELISK NODE markers wholly within your territory. As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in each turning point after the first, you can move each of your OBELISK NODE markers up to 3" horizontally.
 
Your OBELISK NODE markers control other markers within 1" of them that no enemy operatives contest (treat your OBELISK NODE markers as friendly operatives for this purpose).
If more than one player would use their OBELISK NODE markers to control the same marker, no OBELISK NODE markers control it.

Whenever one of your OBELISK NODE markers is within 6" horizontally of another of your OBELISK NODE markers, those markers and the area between them create an OBELISK NODE MATRIX above and below (in other words, their height in the killzone is irrelevant).
If all three of your OBELISK NODE markers fulfil this, it creates a larger combined OBELISK NODE MATRIX.
Whenever a friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative is within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX:
- Weapons on its datacard have the Accurate 1 weapon rule.
- Add 1 to its APL stat (to a maximum of 3).

rule_records.current_text_zh:
每个转折点一次，当另一名己方冥工之环特工将要残废时，如果其对这名特工可见且位于其 6" 内，或者两者都位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内，并且两者都不在敌方特工的控制范围内，可以使用本规则。
该己方特工不会残废，而是剩余 1 点耐伤，并且在该行动余下期间不能残废。行动结束后，该己方特工可以立即执行一次免费冲刺，但必须在这名特工的控制范围内或己方方尖碑节点矩阵内结束行动。两名特工的 APL 属性分别减少 1，直到各自下一次激活结束。如果在获救特工的激活期间使用本规则，其激活结束。
这名特工残废时不能使用本规则；若为射击行动且这名特工是主要或次要目标，也不能使用本规则。
rule_records.website_text_en: Once per turning point, when another friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative would be incapacitated, if that operative is visible to and within 6" of this operative, or if this and that operative are within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that operative is within control range of an enemy operative. If you do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining and cannot be incapacitated for the remainder of the action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately perform a free Dash action, but must end that action within this operative’s control range or within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats until the end of their next activations respectively, and if this rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that activation ends.  You cannot use this rule if this operative is incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would be a primary or secondary target.

rule_records.current_text_zh:
作为第一个转折点的战略计谋，将己方三枚方尖碑节点标识放置在完全位于己方领地的位置。作为第一个转折点之后各转折点的战略计谋，可以将每枚己方方尖碑节点标识水平移动至多 3"。
己方方尖碑节点标识可以控制其 1" 内、没有敌方特工争夺的其他标识（为此将方尖碑节点标识视为己方特工）。如果多名玩家的方尖碑节点标识会控制同一个标识，则没有方尖碑节点标识控制它。
每当一枚己方方尖碑节点标识在水平方向上位于另一枚己方方尖碑节点标识 6" 内，这些标识及其间的区域形成方尖碑节点矩阵，并延伸至上方与下方（杀戮区中的高度不影响此效果）。如果三枚标识都满足条件，则形成更大的组合矩阵。
每当一名己方冥工之环特工位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内：
- 其数据卡上的武器拥有“精准 1”（Accurate 1）武器规则。
- 其 APL 属性增加 1，最多为 3。
rule_records.website_text_en:
As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first turning point, place your three OBELISK NODE markers wholly within your territory. As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in each turning point after the first, you can move each of your OBELISK NODE markers up to 3" horizontally.
 
Your OBELISK NODE markers control other markers within 1" of them that no enemy operatives contest (treat your OBELISK NODE markers as friendly operatives for this purpose).
If more than one player would use their OBELISK NODE markers to control the same marker, no OBELISK NODE markers control it.

Whenever one of your OBELISK NODE markers is within 6" horizontally of another of your OBELISK NODE markers, those markers and the area between them create an OBELISK NODE MATRIX above and below (in other words, their height in the killzone is irrelevant).
If all three of your OBELISK NODE markers fulfil this, it creates a larger combined OBELISK NODE MATRIX.
Whenever a friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative is within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX:
- Weapons on its datacard have the Accurate 1 weapon rule.
- Add 1 to its APL stat (to a maximum of 3).

rule_records.current_text_zh: 轮到激活或反应一名己方特工时，可以改为使用此交战计谋。移动任意数量的己方方尖碑节点标识，水平移动距离合计最多为 6"；每枚标识的移动距离分别向上取整至最接近的整英寸（例如移动 1.5" 视为移动 2"）。可以将一枚标识移动 6"，或者三枚各移动 1"，或任何总计不超过 6" 的组合。也可以移动 0"，相当于跳过这次激活。无论如何，随后对手正常激活。
rule_records.website_text_en: Use this firefight ploy when it’s your turn to activate or counteract. Move any number of your OBELISK NODE markers instead. They can move up to 6" horizontally combined, and distances are always rounded up to the nearest inch (so if you move a marker 1.5", it’s treated as moving it 2"). For example, you could move one marker 6", three markers 1" each, or any combination that doesn’t exceed 6" in total. You can also move them 0" (to effectively skip an activation). In any case, your opponent activates as normal afterwards.

abilities.description: SUPPORT. Select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK operative visible to and within 6" of this operative. Alternatively, you can select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK operative that’s visible to this operative and within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX (SUPPORT doesn’t apply to this selection). That selected operative can immediately perform a 1AP action for free; during that action, it cannot move more than 2", or must be set up wholly within 2" if it’s removed and set up again.  This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or while counteracting.

Select a point on a terrain feature; that point must be visible to and within 8" of this operative. Separately roll 2D6 for each operative within 2" of that point. If the result is higher than that operative’s remaining wounds, inflict damage on it equal to the difference.

This operative cannot perform this action while it has a Conceal order, or while within control range of an enemy operative.

SUPPORT. Select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative visible to and within 6" of this operative. Alternatively, you can select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative visible to this operative and within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX (SUPPORT doesn’t apply to this selection).

The next time the selected operative performs an action in which it moves, don’t move it. Instead, remove it from the killzone and set it back up wholly within a distance equal to its Move stat (or 3" if it was a Dash) horizontally of its
original location (in a killzone that uses the close quarters rules, e.g. Killzone: Tomb World, this distance can be measured over and through Wall terrain and the operative can be set up on the other side). Note that it gains no additional distance when performing the Charge action.
It must be set up in a location it can be placed, and unless it’s the Charge action, it cannot be set up within control range of an enemy operative.

This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

Whenever this operative would perform a mission action (excluding Pick Up Marker or Retrieve, Approved Ops 2025), if it requires this operative to control an objective marker, you can instead determine control from one of your OBELISK NODE markers (see Obelisk Node Matrix faction rule). Whenever this operative would perform the Operate Hatch action, you can open or close a hatchway thats access point is within 1" of one of your OBELISK NODE markers instead. Note that you must still fulfil the Operate Hatch action’s conditions.

As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first turning point, place your three OBELISK NODE markers wholly within your territory. As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in each turning point after the first, you can move each of your OBELISK NODE markers up to 3" horizontally.
 
Your OBELISK NODE markers control other markers within 1" of them that no enemy operatives contest (treat your OBELISK NODE markers as friendly operatives for this purpose).
If more than one player would use their OBELISK NODE markers to control the same marker, no OBELISK NODE markers control it.

Whenever one of your OBELISK NODE markers is within 6" horizontally of another of your OBELISK NODE markers, those markers and the area between them create an OBELISK NODE MATRIX above and below (in other words, their height in the killzone is irrelevant).
If all three of your OBELISK NODE markers fulfil this, it creates a larger combined OBELISK NODE MATRIX.
Whenever a friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative is within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX:
- Weapons on its datacard have the Accurate 1 weapon rule.
- Add 1 to its APL stat (to a maximum of 3).

便携式路障属于轻型、防护和便携地形，但支脚属于无关紧要和暴露地形。战斗开始前，可以将其放在完全位于己方领地、杀戮区地面上，且与其他装备地形、入口及可进入地形相距超过 2" 的位置。
防护：特工从此地形获得掩护时，其豁免属性改善1，最好为2+。
便携：仅当特工与其接触且盾面造成阻碍时提供掩护，忽略支脚。与内侧接触的特工可以执行以下独特行动。
携障移动（1AP）：如同转移行动，但行动特工最多移动其移动属性减去2"的距离，不能攀爬、跳落、跳跃，也不能使用任何将特工移除并重新放置的小队规则，例如炉裔打捞者的飞行或曼德拉的暗影通道。移动前移除与其接触的便携式路障；移动后重新放置，使其再次与特工接触，但不能放在其他装备地形、入口或可进入地形的2"内。
此行动视为转移行动。位于敌方特工控制范围内时不能执行；也不能在已执行后撤或冲锋的同一次激活中执行。
supplementary_universal_equipment.website_text_en: A portable barricade is Light, Protective and Portable terrain, except the feet which are Insignificant and Exposed. Before the battle, you can set it up wholly within your territory, on the killzone floor and more than 2" from other equipment terrain features, access points, and Accessible terrain.     **Protective:** While an operative is in cover from this terrain feature, improve its Save stat by 1 (to a maximum of 2+).    **Portable:** This terrain feature only provides cover while an operative is connected to it and if the shield is intervening (ignore its feet). Operatives connected to the inside of it can perform the following unique action during the battle:    **Move With Barricade (1 AP):** The same as the Reposition action, except the active operative can move no more than its Move stat minus 2" and cannot climb, drop, jump, or use any killteam's rules that remove it and set it back up again (e.gh. HEARTHKYN SALVAGER Fly, MANDRAKE Shadow Passage).    Before this operative moves, remove the portable barricade it is connected to. After it moves, set up the portable barricade so it is connected again, but the portable barricade cannot be set up within 2" of other equipment terrain features, access points or Accessible terrain. If this is not possible, the portable barricade is not set up again.    This action is treated as a Reposition action. An operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or in the same activation in which it performed the Fall Back or Charge action.

supplementary_pdf_only_rules.current_text_zh:
问：三个方尖碑节点标识互相位于6"内时，“之间”是整个三角形还是20mm宽的直线？
答：20mm宽的直线。

问：移动节点标识是否受到可穿越、遮挡、攀爬和跳落规则影响？
答：不会，但标识不能移动穿过地形模型。

问：使用地相技师的控制方尖碑节点规则时，是否使用其APL判断控制？
答：不使用。

问：使用节点响应时，更换后的战略计谋被对手取消，如何处理？
答：可以使用不同的战略计谋，或返还战略计谋与节点响应所消耗的CP。

问：近距离战斗杀戮区中，节点矩阵能穿过墙壁测量吗？
答：不可以。

问：三名巨虫战士均已残废，仍可通过无尽巨虫重新部署一名吗？
答：可以。

问：无尽巨虫部署的战士在其他规则中是否视为新的特工，例如执政官之手的天裂刺客？
答：视为新的特工。

问：两枚节点间有部分墙壁时，能否绕墙测量不超过6"的水平距离来连接？
答：不能。矩阵不会绕过墙壁，必须沿直线测量。

问：矩阵操纵器把地相技师当作节点时，对其50mm底座使用20mm宽直线还是扩宽形状？
答：使用扩宽形状，测量所有面向该底座的距离。图示参见原PDF。
